BiblicalUsage: Once, in the captains of David: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his charge was Ammizabad his son. The name is the son of the mighty man, given charge of his father's division, and the charge is all the Bible says of him.
TheologicalSignificance: A name that is only a son's name carries no lesson of its own. What it shows is the army's order, that the divisions pass from father to son, and the mighty man's son holds his father's place.
